{{Quote|You're a talking Gamorrean.|Unidentified keyboardist to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who played a keyboard that hung from a neck strap and was a member of a [[Unidentified Kuratooine band|band]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> his band was busking for [[credcoin]]s at an open market near the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]] in [[Kura City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. [[Voort saBinring]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], approached the band and gave the keyboardist a [[credcard]], which he checked and confirmed contained a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. saBinring offered them all of the credits in exchange for playing loud music that he could dance to, which the band agreed to. They played a loud rendition of ''[[Torrid Yavin]]'', an anthem for the rebuilding of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. saBinring began dancing to the music and slowly gained an enthusiastic audience, which was all part of his plan to gather witnesses as he and the Wraiths exposed the criminal activities of Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], who was in the vicinity.<ref name="MK" />
